title: Law to set staffing plans for human services contract offices
summary: This law would require the City's chief procurement officer to develop model staffing plans for human services agencies' procurement offices, covering recommended staff numbers, job titles and organizational charts. The plans would be submitted to the Mayor and Council Speaker within 180 days, then shared with agencies for feedback. A follow-up report due 180 days later would summarize agency feedback and compare actual staffing to the model plans.
